statements.note: The line is the one retained option of a template's 'pick one' list (no checkbox), read as the author's selection. The change alters the rendering logic of the SchemaEdge component (required flag sourced from the incoming prop; a previously discarded SchemaNodeDetails JSX is now returned), which is a bug-fix-shaped edit with no exported API change. But whether it is non-breaking for users (rendered output of existing docs changes by design) cannot be settled by a concrete check without the issue reproduction.
